program:
app "Plank" dumbbell ink
table hold note text?
setting length dur = 1m "Plank length"
setting target num = 3 "Daily goal"
timer length, "Plank", add hold then notify "Plank done"
count(hold today) "today" head
stat streak(hold), "day streak"
goal count(hold today), target, "today", "done"
timer 5m, "Rest"
daybars last 7 days, count(hold on it)
list hold today
remind "Time for planks" at 22:00
describe:
Plank, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- hold: note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Plank length": length of time, starts at 1 minute; "Daily goal": number, starts at 3.
Shows:
- a countdown timer of length, labelled "Plank"; when it ends it adds a hold, then shows the notice "Plank done".
- text: how many hold entries today, "today".
- a big number: the current day streak of hold entries, labelled "day streak".
- how many hold entries today out of target with a progress bar, labelled "today".
- a countdown timer of 5 minutes, labelled "Rest"; when it ends it shows the notice "Time is up".
- a bar chart of how many hold entries on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
- a list of hold today; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
Reminder "Time for planks" at 22:00 every day.

fuller_style: a sentence then a list of what is wanted, 20 to 35 words

program:
app "Shop Stock Pro" bag slate
table item name text, buy money, sell money, qty num 0..
table sale item ref item, n num 1..
setting low num = 5 "Low stock level"
let sold = sum(sale today, it.n * it.item.sell)
let profit = sum(sale today, it.n * (it.item.sell - it.item.buy))
row gap 3
  stat sold, "sales today"
  stat profit, "profit today"
each item where qty <= low sort name
  row card
    "Low stock:" it.name it.qty color bad
each item sort name
  row card gap 1
    stack grow
      it.name bold
      "Buy" it.buy "Sell" it.sell faint
    it.qty bold color if(it.qty <= low, bad, ink)
    button "Sell 1" tap add sale item = it, n = 1 then set it.qty = it.qty - 1
form item, "Add item"
describe:
Shop Stock Pro, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- item: name: text; buy: money; sell: money; qty: number, at least 0. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- sale: item: a item; n: number, at least 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Low stock level": number, starts at 5.
Works out:
- sold is the sum of its n times its item sell over the sale today.
- profit is the sum of its n times the result of its item sell minus its item buy over the sale today.
Shows:
- a big number: sold, labelled "sales today".
- a big number: profit, labelled "profit today".
- for each item where qty is at most low sorted by name:
  - text: "Low stock:", its name, its qty.
- for each item sorted by name:
  - text: its name.
  - text: "Buy", its buy, "Sell", its sell.
  - text: its qty.
  - a button "Sell 1"; a tap adds a sale with item set to the item, n set to 1, then sets its qty to its qty minus 1.
- a form to add a item.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: start with who it is for

program:
app "Night Journal" smile ocean
table entry summary text, mood pick "😀"|"🙂"|"😐"|"😟"|"😢" = "🙂", g1 text, g2 text, g3 text
state m date = today
form entry, "Write tonight"

monthnav m
grid 7 gap 1
  each ["M", "T", "W", "T", "F", "S", "S"] as w
    w tiny color muted align center
  each 1..weekday(m - monthday(m) + 1) - 1
    box
  each days month of m as d
    box height 36 radius 6 fill if(count(entry on d) = 0, soft, if(count(entry on d where mood = "😀" or mood = "🙂") > 0, good, if(count(entry on d where mood = "😐") > 0, warn, bad)))
      monthday(d) small align center
list entry by day
